title: Star City Speech  - Videos
description:
Welcome to Star City Speech – your go-to space for clear, confident communication. Whether you're helping your child practice speech sounds, improving your own articulation, or learning English as a second language, you’re in the right place.

I’m Kirsten, a certified speech-language pathologist with nearly a decade of experience supporting children, families, and individuals of all ages. This channel offers simple, effective speech sound practice videos designed for:

🎯 Kids working on articulation or speech delays
🗣️ English learners refining pronunciation and sound production
🎧 Adults seeking accent modification or clear speech strategies
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Parents and educators supporting speech at home or in the classroom

Subscribe and join a growing community committed to clearer speech—one sound at a time.
